# OpenSEO Audit & Strategy

## Core Execution Steps
1. Keyword Research & Intent Mapping: Identify informational vs commercial intent keywords with difficulty benchmarks.
2. Competitive SERP Analysis: Audit top ranking competitors, content length, schema types, and backlink footprints.
3. Technical SEO Health Check: Evaluate page speed, mobile responsiveness, canonicals, robots.txt, and structured data.
4. Content Briefs: Draft outline briefs with target headings (H1/H2/H3), semantic keywords, and internal linking opportunities.
